data.title: Drive the Skid Steer
data.description: A skid steer has no steering wheel. Set its left wheels and right wheels to turn it toward each job.

challenges.instruction: Turn the skid steer to face the log pile. Set the two levers, then press Go.
Turn the skid steer to face the dirt pile. Set the two levers, then press Go.
Turn the skid steer to face the pallet of bricks. Set the two levers, then press Go.
Turn the skid steer to face the little tree. Set the two levers, then press Go.
Turn the skid steer to face the hay bale. Set the two levers, then press Go.
